summary.headline: Mars–Mercury Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mars and Mercury, distinguishing Mars or Mercury elevated and placements in Sagittarius, the earthy triplicity, Taurus, and Virgo. Omens include plague, war, political unrest, theft, crop failure, weather changes, and calamities affecting Rome, Mecca, Fars, Khuzestan, and Arab Iraq.
